name: nodebi
description: Self-hosted dashboard designer and business intelligence workspace.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.ci:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for(const p of ['server/dist','client/dist']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.package:win: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run package:win:binary
scripts.package:win:binary: pkg . --targets node20-win-x64 --output release/nodebi.raw.exe && node scripts/embed-win-icon.mjs release/nodebi.raw.exe assets/nodebi.ico release/nodebi.exe && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('release/nodebi.raw.exe')"
